langCode.description: This translation's language code (en, de, pt_BR…), used as the page's lang attribute.

extDescription.message: Weighs your search results: tag, rerank and hide sites, with lists anyone can publish.
extDescription.description: Shown in the stores and the browser's add-ons page. At most 132 characters.

commandToggleEnabled.description: Keyboard shortcut, listed in the browser's shortcut settings.

commandToggleHidden.message: Show hidden results, or hide them again
commandToggleHidden.description: Keyboard shortcut, listed in the browser's shortcut settings.

levelHide.description: A site's ranking. The five rankings are Hide, Lower, Normal, Raise and Pin.

levelPin.description: A site's ranking: always at the top.

popupOff.message: Off. Search pages are left as they are.

popupOnLabel.description: Screen reader label of the on/off switch.

popupRanking.description: Screen reader label of the ranking menu next to Add a site.

popupNoSites.message: Nothing yet. Use the ⇅ button on any search result, or add a site above.

popupKeptNormal.description: A site set to Normal on purpose, overriding lists.

popupListsAndTags.description: $1 is the number of lists (popupListCount), $2 the number of tags (popupTagCount).

popupRankingFor.description: Screen reader label; $1 is a site.

popupRankPin.message: Pin $1 to the top of search results

popupThisPageOn.description: $1 is a search engine, e.g. Google.

popupNotSearch.message: Search on Google, DuckDuckGo, Bing, Brave or another supported engine to see what Anubis changes.

hideAgain.description: Hides the results Show hidden brought back.

loadMoreTitle.message: Add the next page of results to the page and rank them together

popupSettings.description: Label of the cog button in the toolbar popup.

withShortcut.description: A button's description followed by its keyboard shortcut, e.g. Show hidden (Alt+Shift+H).

hiddenMore_one.description: After a site's name on the one line standing for several hidden results in a row, e.g. “fandom.com and 1 more hidden by your list”.

offerTitle.description: Settings → Lists, after a subscribe link opened it. $1 is the list's name.

offerTrust.message: A list can hide, rank and tag sites in your results. Only subscribe to lists you trust.

offerPermission.message: Your browser will then ask to let Anubis read from $1, the site the list is on.

welcomeTitle.description: Tab title of the page that opens when Anubis is installed.

welcomeIntro.message: It tags, reranks and hides search results, following your own choices and the lists you subscribe to.

welcomePinWhy.message: Its toolbar button shows what Anubis did on the page, turns it on or off, and ranks the site you're on.

welcomePinChrome.message: Press the Extensions button (the puzzle piece) next to the address bar, then the pin beside Anubis.

welcomePinEdge.message: Press the Extensions button (the puzzle piece) next to the address bar, then the eye beside Anubis.

welcomePinOpera.message: Press the Extensions button (the cube) next to the address bar, then the pin beside Anubis.

welcomePinFirefox.message: Press the Extensions button (the puzzle piece) next to the address bar, then the gear beside Anubis, and choose Pin to Toolbar.

welcomePinAndroid.message: Anubis is in the browser's menu, under Extensions.

welcomePinned.description: Shown instead of the steps once the browser says the button is pinned.

welcomeSearchHow.message: Search as you usually do. To hide, rank or tag a site, point at one of its results and press the ⇅ button.

welcomeSearchFor.message: Search for “$1” to see tags from your lists:
welcomeSearchFor.description: $1 is welcomeQuery. Followed by one link per search engine.

welcomeSearchOn.description: Tooltip of a search engine link. $1 is welcomeQuery, $2 a search engine, e.g. Google.

welcomeQuery.description: A search whose results include official documentation, forums and Wikipedia, so the starter lists show their tags. Keep it technical.

welcomeListsIntro.message: Lists tag, raise, lower or hide sites for you. You start with these:

welcomeListsNone.message: Lists tag, raise, lower or hide sites for you. You aren't subscribed to any yet.

welcomeListsMore.message: Turn these off, or find more lists, in the settings.
